sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires nonempty name:string; optional id:exact appearance ID, library:exact loaded library ID, surfaceType:opaque|metal|transparent. Discover IDs with appearance.list {}; query a loaded library for foreign IDs. Passing id/library copies that appearance into the Design with the new name (Appearances.addByCopy); omitting id uses the preview Appearances.add when the SDK exposes it. New name must be unique among design appearances; a local ID/name collision is rejected, never assumed equivalent.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: The copy is design-local and its actual ID is authoritative, never assumed from the requested name. A library resource is never edited in place. No physical material, coating or mass is implied. No rollback; a runtime failure may leave the copy.

Wrapper:{success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:reference[]}.

examples.requires: Earlier styles: appearance.list {} returns a loaded library and items; standalone substitute actual id/library and a unique design name.
examples.output: result.id is the actual local copy ID; reuse it without library on later assignments.

examples.requires: appearance-id from a prior appearance.list {}; unique new name in the design.
examples.output: result.copiedFrom=appearance-id; created.id is the new local ID.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires id:exact design-local appearance ID; optional name:string and properties:nonempty array of {id,value}. Discover IDs with appearance.list {}. Library appearances are rejected; copy first with appearance.create. property value types: FloatProperty finite number, IntegerProperty int, BooleanProperty bool, StringProperty string, ChoiceProperty choice name string, ColorProperty [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] integers 0..255.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Only design-local resources are edited. Read-only properties are rejected. Setting a FloatProperty value removes any connected texture. name must remain unique. No rollback; a runtime failure may leave partial edits.

examples.requires: appearance-id is a design-local appearance from appearance.list {}; surface_roughness exists in its appearanceProperties.
examples.output: result.changed=true; result.after.properties reflects the new value; propertyChanges[0].before/after are typed.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires id:design-local appearance ID and channel:color|normal|roughness; optional image:path string (empty disconnects), scaleX/scaleY:length expressions, rotation:angle expression, bump:boolean, lock:boolean (true makes scaleX/scaleY follow each other when only one is given). Use appearance.create to obtain a design-local appearance. The image path is on the Fusion host.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: colorTexture/normalTexture/roughnessTexture are preview setters; the image is embedded in the document but the returned path may differ after save/reopen. Real-world scale and bump are set through appearanceProperties only when a writable property exists; a missing property is a blocked sub-request, never silently ignored. Setting a texture on normal with bump:true selects a height-map bump.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass|blocked, operation:appearance.texture, documentIdentity, units, frame, associativity:nativeProperty, warnings:string[], method, limitations, provenance, affected:[{ref:{kind:appearance,id:string},before:{channel:string,image:string},after:{channel:string,image:string}}], result:{id:string,channel:string,before:{channel:string,image:string},after:{channel:string,image:string},changed:string[],realWorldScale:{scaleX?:number,scaleY?:number},bump:boolean|null,rotation:number|null}.

examples.requires: appearance-id is design-local; height.png exists on the Fusion host.
examples.output: result.after.image is the connected path; result.bump=true when bumpmap_Type is writable.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires id:design-local appearance ID; optional projection:automatic|planar|box|spherical|cylindrical. Omitting projection reads the current type. The projection is read/written through the appearance texture property (texture_ProjectionType).

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Projection is a texture property, not a geometric projection frame. If the installed SDK exposes no writable projection property, a set request is blocked (status blocked), never silently substituted.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass|blocked, operation:appearance.projection, documentIdentity, units, frame, associativity, warnings, method, limitations, provenance, affected:[{ref:{kind:appearance,id:string},before:value,after:value}], result:{id:string,projection:value,changed:boolean,requested?:string,before:value,after:value}.

examples.label: Set planar projection
examples.requires: appearance-id is design-local and exposes a writable texture_ProjectionType.
examples.output: result.after is the readback projection value; result.changed=true.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Optional refs:nonempty array of Component/BRepBody/BRepFace/Occurrence refs (omit to map all bodies/components/faces/occurrences) and expected:map of {ref name -> expected appearance id}. Discover refs with entity.list/entity.find. Omitted refs map every discovered entity.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Read-only. A face reads its body appearance and an occurrence reads its component definition. Equal IDs do not establish inheritance provenance. Mismatches are reported with expected/actual/resolvedExpected; a duplicate name is never assumed equivalent.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires name:nonempty unique design name and id:exact material ID; optional library:exact loaded library ID. Discover with material.list {}. Copies the material into the Design with the new name (Materials.addByCopy). A local ID/name collision is rejected.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Physical materials are copied, not created from scratch. The actual copy ID is authoritative. No density/mass/coating validation. A library material is never edited in place.

examples.requires: Earlier materials: material.list {} returns a loaded library and items; standalone substitute actual id/library and a unique design name.
examples.output: result.id is the actual local copy ID; reuse it without library on later assignments.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires id:exact design-local material ID; optional name:string, description:string, properties:nonempty array of {id,value}. Discover IDs with material.list {}. Library materials are rejected; copy first with material.create. Typed property values follow the same rules as appearance.edit.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Only design-local materials are edited. A missing density is reported, never replaced by a default. Physical material and visual appearance are separate. No rollback.

examples.requires: material-id is design-local and exposes a writable density property.
examples.output: result.propertyChanges[0].after.value reflects the new density; a missing density property is reported, not defaulted.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Optional refs:nonempty array and expected:map of {ref name -> expected material id}. Omit refs to map every discovered entity. A face reads its body material and an occurrence reads its component definition.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Read-only. Equal IDs do not establish inheritance. No mass or density validation. Mismatches are reported explicitly.

examples.requires: Earlier bodies: entity.list {kind:body}; material-id from material.list {}. Standalone substitute actual ref and expected id.
examples.output: result.mismatchCount=0 when the body's material matches material-id.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Optional refs:nonempty array to scope the report; omit to map all bodies/components/faces/occurrences. The report aggregates appearance and material state per entity and scans design appearances/materials for duplicate names/IDs and missing densities.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Read-only. A duplicate name/ID is reported, not assumed equivalent. A missing material density is reported, never replaced. Appearance and physical material are reported separately.
